analysis: Reviewed scripts/test-provider-release-pipeline.py (base and head). It is a text-based unit test pinning release workflow structure; it holds no runtime provider, coordinator or key-handling code and ships in no artifact. Visible head changes: the new constants FACTS_SCRIPT, FACTS_STEP, SHOW_STEP and RETAIN_STEP and a step() helper (lines 16-24); qualify-sdk renamed to qualify-sdk-shard in several assertions (167, 177, 189, 265); the blanket assertNotIn('continue-on-error:', RELEASE) replaced with an exact count of 3 plus per-step checks (209-215); and an assertion that the audio fixture and gate steps run only on the last shard (393-395). Security notes: (1) continue-on-error is now permitted for the cluster runtime facts steps. The test still requires it to be false when CLUSTER_RUNTIME_SEND == 'true', and it keeps the ACTION assertNotIn, so required signing and release steps remain pinned. Weakening is bounded to 3 occurrences, though the count is a coarse check that cannot tell which steps carry them beyond the named ones. (2) Line 206 still asserts needs: [resolve-env, build-provider, qualify-sdk] for signing. Line 265 now lists both qualify-sdk-shard and qualify-sdk as jobs. The sharded qualification becomes an aggregate qualify-sdk. The tests do not themselves prove the aggregate depends on all shards, so signing could pass with a skipped shard. The workflow YAML (release-provider.yml) is not in the supplied evidence, so this cannot be checked here. (3) The new cluster-runtime-facts script and its workflow steps are unseen. How the facts are computed from the signed app and sent in the release payload, and whether they influence build qualification (A-017, T-054), needs review in the workflow and script files. The unit patch excerpt is truncated (head lines 464-645 are not visible), so the added tests there are not reviewed. No regression is identified in the visible test file, but integration should confirm that the shard aggregate gates signing and that the facts steps cannot alter release trust.
